notes.title: MusicLabeLManager 2K21
notes.notes: [b]MusicLabelManager[/b] is a music industry simulator that allows players to create and run their own record label. Players take the role of CEO and try to make their mark on the music industry. The game has a database with more than 1000 real artists with stats for 2021. Music awards, singles, concert tours, streaming services and much more. The best music tycoon on the market!
